10 }} }} }} The '''Caller Set''' is a [[Deep North]]-tier mage [[armor]]. == Armor pieces == This set of armor has three pieces. The pieces cannot be crafted directly. Instead the player must craft the corresponding [[Cast]] at a level 3 [[Galdr Table]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. Hardening a cast takes 50 seconds and burns [[Liquid Frost]] as fuel at one unit every 10 seconds, and five units are required per cast. The armor can be repaired at a level 3 Galdr Table. Since the maximum Galdr Table level is 5, the pieces cannot currently be upgraded past quality 3. The [[Forge of Potential]] upgrade for these pieces uses a [[Bloodgold Protection Idol]]. There is no set bonus. === Moulds === Each of the three moulds has a 5% chance to drop from a [[Hexen]]. === Effects === * {{Item Link|Headdress of the Caller}}: +40% [[Eitr]] regeneration. * {{Item Link|Robes of the Caller}}: +60% Eitr regeneration, -2% movement speed, [[Resistance|resistant]] vs. [[Frost]]. * {{Item Link|Trousers of the Caller}}: +60% Eitr regeneration, -2% movement speed. === Quality === 1= === Quality 1 === Galdr Table level: 3 (cast)
